title: E-FRC-0291: explores whether a Sigma(648) colour field can carry a wall index that breaks the one-wall member...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0291 in the gauge arena: explores whether a Sigma(648) colour field can carry a wall index that breaks the one-wall member number: the register bulk gap stays open up to flux 1/6 per cell and closes at 2/9; the uniform and the lumpy group-valued fields close it, but dilute sheets of the order-9 element (h on one strip of every second to fourth column) keep it open and each colour component flows 4 p on wall A and -4 p on wall B at depths 12 and 16.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
